title: Intrinsic and extrinsic effects on image memorability
authors: Zoya Bylinskii, Phillip Isola, Constance Bainbridge, Antonio Torralba, Aude Oliva
caption_short: An example AMT experimental sequence: a stream of scene images (1.0 s each, separated by a 1.4 s fixation cross) in which the participant presses a key on repeats and receives immediate feedback, illustrating hits, false alarms and correct rejections.
